1. Rewriting some parts to be easier to follow
2. Add warnings regarding security concerns in some places
3. Make headers unified in terms of hierarchy
4. Update some links
5. In most cases, change `webserver` to `apiServer`
6. Remove some duplicated information between different sections
7. Remove information that KEDA is experimental (it is so long in the chart that I thought that maybe it is about time)
8. Finally..., remove some missed parts in the mentioned PR 😄

**Edit**: Additional things done:
1. Fix indent to match official Sphinx doc (3 spaces)
